source.review: X1-06 wave 1 — buff and control spells whose combat effect the existing kinds express: Invisible condition, attack-roll advantage/disadvantage riders, temporary HP, and a save-gated concentration effect. Each executionScope states what is not enforced (early-end triggers, per-slot extra targets, ability narrowing). Heroism was reviewed and left to prose derivation: its temporary HP equals the spellcasting ability modifier alone, which the temporary-hp formula cannot express without dice or a flat base.

primary.summary: 접촉한 크리처 하나가 주문이 끝날 때까지 투명 상태가 된다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored: the touched creature gains the Invisible condition while the caster concentrates (up to 1 hour). The early end when the target attacks, deals damage, or casts, and the extra target per slot level above 2nd, are not enforced.

primary.summary: 접촉한 크리처 하나가 주문이 끝날 때까지 투명 상태가 된다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored: the touched creature is Invisible while the caster concentrates (up to 1 minute); no early-end trigger exists for this spell.

primary.summary: 지속시간 동안 모든 크리처는 당신을 대상으로 하는 명중 굴림에 불리점을 받는다.

trackedEffects.summary: 당신을 대상으로 하는 명중 굴림에 불리점

definitions.executionScope: Authored: attack rolls against the caster have disadvantage while concentrating (up to 1 minute). Attackers with blindsight or truesight are not exempted.

primary.summary: 실패한 크리처는 지속시간 동안 윤곽이 드러나 그를 향한 명중 굴림에 이점이 붙고 투명 상태의 이득을 받지 못한다.

trackedEffects.summary: 영향을 받은 크리처를 향한 명중 굴림에 이점

definitions.executionScope: Authored: each chosen creature in the 20-foot cube (up to ten within 60 feet; the DM validates the cube) saves against Dexterity; on a failure attack rolls against it have advantage while the caster concentrates. Objects, the dim light, and the loss of Invisible benefits are not modeled.

primary.summary: 실패한 대상은 이동 속도 절반, AC와 민첩 내성 −2, 반응행동 불가, 턴마다 행동 또는 추가 행동 하나, 공격 행동 시 공격 한 번 (추적)

definitions.executionScope: Authored: up to six creatures in the 40-foot cube (the DM validates the cube) save against Wisdom; a failure is a tracked concentration effect. The speed, AC, reaction, action, and spell-failure penalties and the repeat saves are not enforced.
Authored: the 700-HP pool heals one creature (dividing it among several creatures is not modeled) and removes Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned from it.
